title: Childcare & Early Years Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=nanny:timesheet) OR (index=personal sourcetype=brightwheel:checkin)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="nanny:timesheet","primary",sourcetype="brightwheel:checkin","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from nanny:timesheet and brightwheel:checkin to see whether two childcare feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `nanny:timesheet` and `brightwheel:checkin` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main childcare data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
